mana rakshakudaina dhevuniyokkayu mana nireekshanayaina kreesthuyesuyokkayu aagnaprakaaramu kreesthuyesu yokka aposthaludaina paulu,

vishvaasamunubatti naa nija maina kumaarudagu thimothiki shubhamani cheppi vraayunadhi. thandriyaina dhevuninundiyu mana prabhuvaina kreesthuyesu nundiyu krupayu kanikaramunu samaadhaanamunu neeku kalugunu gaaka.
nenu maasidoniyaku velluchundagaa satyamunaku bhinnamaina bodha cheyavaddaniyu, kalpanaakathalunu mithamu leni vamshaavalulunu,

vishvaasasambandhamaina dhevuni yerpaa tuthoo kaaka vivaadamulathoone sambandhamu kaligiyunnavi ganuka, vaatini lakshyapettavaddaniyu, kondariki aagnaapinchu taku neevu ephesulo nilichiyundavalenani ninnu heccha rinchina prakaaramu ippudunu heccharinchuchunnaanu.
upadheshasaaramedhanagaa, pavitra hrudayamunundiyu, manchi manassaakshinundiyu, nishkapatamaina vishvaasamu nundiyu kalugu premaye.
kondaru veetini maanukoni tolagipoyi, thaamu cheppuvaatinainanu,
nishchayamainattu roodhigaa palukuvaatinainanu grahimpaka poyinanu dharmashaastropadheshakulai yundagori vish‌prayojanamaina mucchatalaku thirigiri.
ayinanu shreemanthudagu dhevudu naaku appaginchina aayana mahimagala suvaarthaprakaaramu,

dharmashaastramu dharmavirodhulakunu avidheyulakunu bhakthi heenulakunu paapishtulakunu apavitrulakunu mathadoosha kulakunu pitruhanthakulakunu maatruhanthakulakunu nara hanthakulakunu vyabhichaarulakunu purushasanyogulakunu manushya choorulakunu abaddhikulakunu apramaanikulakunu,
hithabodhaku virodhiyainavaadu mari evadainanu undina yedala, attivaanikini niyamimpabadenugaani,
neethimanthuniki niyamimpabadaledani yevadainanu erigi, dharmaanukoolamugaa daanini upayoginchinayedala dharmashaastramu melainadani manamerugudumu.
poorvamu dooshakudanu hinsakudanu haanikarudanaina nannu, thana paricharyaku niyaminchi nammakamaina vaanigaa enchinanduku,
nannu balaparachina mana prabhuvaina kreesthu yesuku kruthagnudanai yunnaanu. Teliyaka avishvaasamu valana chesithini ganuka kanikarimpabadithini.
mariyu mana prabhuvuyokka krupayu, kreesthu yesunandunna vishvaa samunu premayu, atyadhikamugaa vistharinchenu.
paapulanu rakshinchutaku kreesthuyesu lokamunaku vacchenanu vaakyamu nammathaginadhiyu poornaangeekaaramunaku yogya mainadhiyunai yunnadhi. Atti vaarilo nenu pradhaanudanu.

ayinanu nityajeevamu nimitthamu thananu vishvasimpa bovuvaariki nenu maadhirigaa undulaaguna yesukreesthu thana poornamaina deerghashaanthamunu aa pradhaanapaapinaina naayandu kanuparachunatlu nenu kanikarimpabadithini.
sakala yugamulalo raajaiyundi, akshayudunu adru shyudunagu advitheeya dhevuniki ghanathayu mahimayu yugayugamulu kalugunu gaaka. aamen‌.

naa kumaaruduvaina thimothee, neevu vishvaasamunu manchi manassaakshiyu kaliginavaadavai, ninnugoorchi mundhugaa cheppabadina pravachanamula choppuna ee manchi poraatamu poraadavalenani vaatinibatti yee aagnanu neeku appaginchuchunnaanu.
atti manassaakshini kondaru trosivesi, vishvaasavishayamai oda baddalai poyinavaarivale chediyunnaaru.
vaarilo humenaiyunu aleksandrunu unnaaru; veeru dooshimpakunda shikshimpabadutakai veerini saathaanunaku appaginchithini.
manamu sampoornabhakthiyu maanyathayu kaligi, nemmadhi gaanu sukhamugaanu braduku nimitthamu, annitikante mukhyamugaa manushyulandarikorakunu
raajulakorakunu adhikaarulandarikorakunu vignaapanamulunu praarthanalunu yaachanalunu kruthagnathaasthuthulunu cheyavalenani heccha rinchuchunnaanu.
idi manchidiyu mana rakshakudagu dhevuni drushtiki anukoolamainadhiyunai yunnadhi.
aayana, manushyulandaru rakshanapondi satyamunugoorchina anubhavagnaanamugalavaarai yundavalenani yicchayinchu chunnaadu.
dhevudokkade, dhevunikini narulakunu madhya varthiyu okkade; aayana kreesthuyesanu narudu.
eeyana andarikoraku vimochana krayadhanamugaa thannuthaane samarpinchukonenu. Deeninigoorchina saakshyamu yuktha kaalamulayandu iyyabadunu.

ee saakshyamichutakai nenu prakatinchuvaadanugaanu, aposthaludanugaanu, vishvaasa satyamula vishayamulo anyajanulaku bodhakudanu gaanu niyamimpabadithini. Nenu satyame cheppuchunnaanu, abaddhamaadutaledu.
kaavuna prathisthalamandunu purushulu kopamunu sanshayamunu lenivaarai, pavitramaina chethuletthi praarthana cheyavalenani koruchunnaanu.

mariyu streelunu anukuvayu svasthabuddhiyu galavaarai yundi, thagumaatrapu vastramula chethanegaani jadalathoonainanu bangaaramuthoonainanu mutyamulathoonainanu migula velagala vastramulathoonainanu alankarinchukonaka,
daivabhakthigalavaaramani cheppukonu streelaku thaginattugaa sat‌kriyalachetha thammunu thaamu alankarinchu konavalenu.
streelu maunamugaa undi, sampoorna vidheyathathoo nerchukonavalenu.
stree maunamugaa undavalasinadhegaani, upadheshinchutakainanu, purushunimeeda adhikaaramu cheyutakainanu aameku selaviyyanu.
modata aadaamunu tharuvaatha havvayunu nirmimpabadiri kaaraa?
mariyu aadaamu mosaparachabadaledu gaani, stree mosa parachabadi aparaadhamulo padenu.
ayinanu vaaru svasthabuddhikaligi, vishvaasaprema parishuddhathalayandu nilukadagaa undinayedala shishuprasoothidvaaraa aame rakshimpa badunu.
evadainanu adhyakshapadavini aashinchinayedala attivaadu doddapanini apekshinchuchunnaadanu maata nammadaginadhi.
adhyakshudaguvaadu nindaarahithudunu, ekapatnee purushu dunu, mithaanubhavudunu, svasthabuddhigalavaadunu, maryaadasthudunu, athithipriyudunu, bodhimpathaginavaadunai yundi,
madyapaaniyu kottuvaadunukaaka, saatvi kudunu, jagadamaadanivaadunu, dhanaapekshalenivaadunai,
sampoornamaanyatha kaligi thana pillalanu svaadheenaparachukonuchu, thana yintivaarini baagugaa eluvaadunai yundavalenu.
evadainanu thana yintivaarini elaneraka poyinayedala athadu dhevuni sanghamunu elaagu paalinchunu?
athadu garvaandhudai apavaadhiki kaligina shikshaavidhiki lobadakundunatlu krotthagaa cherinavaadai yundakoodadu.
mariyu athadu nindapaalai apavaadhi urilo padipokundunatlu sanghamunaku velupativaarichetha manchi saakshyamu pondina vaadaiyundavalenu.
aalaagunane parichaarakulu maanyulai yundi, dvimanaskulunu, migula madyapaanaasakthulunu, durlaabhamuna pekshinchuvaarunaiyundaka
vishvaasamarmamunu pavitramaina manassaakshithoo gaikonuvaarai yundavalenu.
mariyu vaaru modata pareekshimpabadavalenu; tharuvaatha vaaru anindyulaithe parichaarakulugaa undavachunu.
atuvale paricharyacheyu streelunu maanyulai kondemulu cheppanivaarunu, mithaanu bhavamugalavaarunu, anni vishaya mulalo nammakamainavaarunai yundavalenu.
parichaarakulu ekapatnee purushulunu, thama pillalanu thama yintivaarini baagugaa eluvaarunai yundavalenu.
parichaarakulaiyundi aa panini baagugaa neraverchinavaaru manchi padavini sampaadhinchukoni kreesthuyesunandali vishvaasamandu bahu dhairyamu galavaaraguduru.
sheeghramugaa neeyoddhaku vatthunani nireekshinchuchunnaanu;

ayinanu nenu aalasyamuchesinayedala dhevuni mandiramulo, anagaa jeevamugala dhevuni sanghamulo, janulelaagu pravarthimpavaleno adhi neeku teliyavalenani yee sangathulanu neeku vraayuchunnaanu. aa sanghamu satyamunaku sthambhamunu aadhaaramunai yunnadhi.¸

niraa kshepamugaa daivabhakthini goorchina marmamu goppadaiyunnadhi;aayana sashareerudugaa pratyakshudayyenu.aatmavishayamuna neethiparudani theerpunondhenu dhevadoothalaku kanabadenu rakshakudani janamulalo prakatimpabadenu lokamandu nammabadenu aarohanudai thejomayudayyenu.
ayithe kadavari dinamulalo kondaru abaddhikula veshadhaaranavalana mosaparachu aatmalayandunu
dayyamula bodhayandunu lakshyamunchi, vishvaasa bhrashtulagudurani aatma thetagaa cheppuchunnaadu.

aa abaddhikulu, vaatha veyabadina manassaakshigalavaarai, vivaahamunishedhinchuchu, satyavishayamai anubhavagnaanamugala vishvaasulu kruthagna thaasthuthulu chellinchi puchukonunimitthamu dhevudu srujinchina aahaaravasthuvulanu konnitini thinuta maanavalenani cheppu chunduru.
dhevudu srujinchina prathi vasthuvunu manchidi. Kruthagnathaasthuthulu chellinchi puchukoninayedala ediyu nishedhimpathaginadhi kaadu;
yelayanagaa adhi dhevuni vaakyamu valananu praarthanavalananu pavitraparacha baduchunnadhi.
ee sangathulanu sahodarulaku vivarinchinayedala,neevu anusarinchuchu vachina vishvaasa subodha sambandhamaina vaakyamulachetha pempaaruchu kreesthuyesunaku manchi parichaarakudavai yunduvu.
apavitramulaina musalamma mucchatalanu visarjinchi, dhevabhakthi vishayamulo neeku neeve saadhakamu chesikonumu.

shareera sambandhamaina saadhakamu konchemumattuke prayojanakaramavunu gaani daivabhakthiyippati jeevamu vishayamulonu raabovu jeevamu vishayamulonu vaagdaanamuthoo koodinadainanduna adhi anni vishayamulalo prayojanakaramavunu.
ee vaakyamu nammadaginadhiyu poornaangeekaaramunaku yogya munaiyunnadhi.
manushyulakandariki rakshakudunu, mari visheshamugaa vishvaasulaku rakshakudunaina jeevamugala dhevuni yandu manamu nireekshananunchiyunnaamu ganuka indu nimitthamu prayaasamuthoo paatupaduchunnaamu.
ee sangathula naagnaapinchi bodhinchumu.
nee ¸yauvanamunubatti evadunu ninnu truneekarimpaniyyakumu gaani, maatalonu, pravarthanalonu, premalonu, vishvaasamulonu, pavitrathalonu, vishvaasulaku maadhirigaa undumu.
nenu vachuvaraku chaduvutayandunu, heccharinchutayandunu, bodhinchutayandunu jaagratthagaa undumu.
peddalu hasthanikshepanamucheyagaa pravachanamoolamuna neeku anugrahimpabadi neelo unna varamunu alakshyamu cheyakumu.
nee abhivruddhi andariki thetagaa kanabadu nimitthamu veetini manaskarinchumu, veetiyandhe saadhakamu chesikonumu.
ninnugoorchiyu nee bodhanu goorchiyu jaagrattha kaligiyundumu, veetilo nilukadagaa undumu; neeveelaaguchesi ninnunu nee bodha vinuvaarini rakshinchukonduvu.
vruddhuni gaddimpaka thandrigaa bhaavinchi athani heccharinchumu.
annadammulani ¸yauvanulanu, thallulani vruddha streelanu, akkachellendrani poornapavitrathathoo yauvana streelanu heccharinchumu.
nijamugaa anaathalaina vidhavaraandranu sanmaanimpumu.

ayithe e vidhavaraalikainanu pillalugaani manumalugaani yundinayedala, veeru modata thama yintivaariyedala bhakthi kanuparachutakunu, thama thalidandrulaku pratyupakaaramu cheyutakunu nerchukonavalenu; idi dhevunidrushtikanukoolamaiyunnadhi.
ayithe nijamugaa anaathayaina vidhavaraalu ekaakiyai yundi, dhevunimeedane thana nireekshananunchukoni, vignaapanalayandunu praarthanalayandunu reyimbagalu nilukadagaa undunu.
sukhabhogamulayandu pravarthinchunadhi braduku chundiyu chachinadaiyundunu.
vaaru nindaarahithulai yundunatlu eelaagu aagnaapinchumu.
evadainanu svakeeyulanu, visheshamugaa thana yintivaarini, sanrakshimpaka poyinayedala vaadu vishvaasatyaagamu chesinavaadai avishvaasikanna cheddavaadai yundunu.
aruvadhi endla kante thakkuvavayassu leka, okka purushunike bhaaryayai,

sat‌kriyalaku perupondina vidhavaraalu pillalanu penchi, paradheshulaku athithyamichi, parishuddhula paadamulu kadigi, shramapaduvaariki sahaayamuchesi, prathi satkaaryamucheya boonukoninadaithe aamenu vidhavaraandra lekkalo cherchavachunu.
¸yauvanasthulaina vidhava raandranu lekkalo cherchavaddu;
vaaru kreesthunaku virodhamugaa nirankushalainappudu thama modati vishvaasamunu vadalukoniranu theerpupondinavaarai pendlaadagoruduru.
mariyu vaaru intinta thirugulaaduchu, baddhakuraaṁ dragutaku maatramegaaka, aadaraani maatalaaduchu, vadaru bothulunu parulajoliki povuvaarunagutakunu nerchu konduru.
kaabatti ¸yauvana streelu vivaahamu chesikoni pillalanu kani gruhaparipaalana jariginchuchu, nindinchutaku virodhiki avakaashamiyyakundavalenani koru chunnaanu.
inthakumundhe kondaru trovanundi tolagi poyi saathaanunu vembadinchinavaarairi.

vishvaasuraalaina ye stree yintanainanu vidhavaraandrundinayedala, sanghamu nijamugaa anaathalaina vidhavaraandraku sahaayamu cheyutakai daanimeeda bhaaramulekunda aameye veeriki sahaayamu cheyavalenu.
baagugaa paalanacheyu peddalanu, visheshamugaa vaakya mandunu upadheshamandunu prayaasapaduvaarini, rettimpu sanmaanamunaku paatrulanugaa enchavalenu.
induku noorchedi yeddu moothiki chikkamu veyavaddu ani lekhanamu cheppuchunnadhi.
mariyu panivaadu thana jeethamunaku paatrudu iddaru mugguru saakshuluntenegaani peddameeda doshaa ropana angeekarimpakumu
itharulu bhayapadunimitthamu paapamu cheyuvaarini andariyeduta gaddimpumu.

virodha buddhithoonainanu pakshapaathamuthoonainanu emiyucheyaka, nenu cheppina ee sangathulanu gaikonavalenani dhevuni yedutanu, kreesthuyesu edutanu, erparachabadina dheva doothalayedutanu neeku aanabettuchunnaanu.
tvarapadi yevanimeedhanainanu hasthanikshepanamu cheyakumu. Parulapaapa mulalo paalivaadavai yundakumu. neevu pavitrudavugaa undunatlu choochukonumu.
ikameedata neelletraagaka nee kadupu jabbunimitthamunu tharachugaa vachu balaheenathala kosaramunu draakshaarasamu konchemugaa puchukonumu.
kondari paapamulu thetagaa bayalupadi nyaayapu theerpunaku mundhugaa naduchuchunnavi, marikondari paapamulu vaariventa velluchunnavi.
atuvale manchikaaryamulu thetagaa bayalupaduchunnavi, bayalupadanivi daachabadaneravu.
dhevuni naamamunu aayana bodhayu dooshimpabada kundunatlu daasatvamanu kaadikrinda unnavaarandarunu, thama yajamaanulu poornamaina ghanathaku paatrulani yencha valenu.

vishvaasulaina yajamaanulugala daasulu thama yajamaanulu sahodarulani vaarini truneekarimpaka, thama sevaaphalamu ponduvaaru vishvaasulunu priyulunai yunnaarani mari yekkuvagaa vaariki sevacheyavalenu; ee sangathulu bodhinchuchu vaarini heccharinchumu.
evadainanu mana prabhuvaina yesukreesthuyokka hitha vaakyamulanu daivabhakthiki anugunyamaina bodhanu angeekarimpaka, bhinnamainabodhanupadheshinchinayedala
vaademiyu erugaka tharkamulanugoorchiyu vaagvaadamulanu goorchiyu vyarthamugaa prayaasapaduchu garvaandhudagunu. Veetimoolamugaa asooya kalahamu dooshanalu duranumaanamulunu,
chedipoyina manassukaligi satyaheenulai daivabhakthi laabhasaadhanamanukonu manushyula vyarthavivaadamulunu kaluguchunnavi.
santhushti sahithamaina daivabhakthi goppalaabhasaadhanamai yunnadhi.
manameelokamuloniki emiyu theledu, deenilonundi emiyu theesikoni polemu.
kaagaa annavastramulu galavaaramai yundi vaatithoo trupthipondiyundamu.
dhanavanthulagutaku apekshinchu vaaru shodhanalonu, urilonu, aviveka yukthamulunu haanikaramulunaina aneka duraashalalonu paduduru. Attivi manushyulanu nashtamulonu naashanamulonu munchiveyunu.
endukanagaa dhanaapekshasamasthamaina keedulaku moolamu; kondaru daanini aashinchi vishvaasamunundi tolagipoyi naanaabaadhalathoo thammunu thaame poduchukoniri.
daivajanudaa, neevaithe veetivi visarjinchi, neethini bhakthini vishvaasamunu premanu orpunu saatvikamunu sampaadhinchukonutaku prayaasapadumu.
vishvaasasambandhamaina manchi poraatamu poraadumu, nityajeevamunu chepattumu. daani pondutaku neevu piluvabadi aneka saakshulayeduta manchi oppukolu oppukontivi.
samasthamunaku jeevaa dhaarakudaina dhevuni yedutanu, ponthipilaathunoddha dhairya mugaa oppukoni saakshyamichina kreesthuyesu edutanu,
mana prabhuvaina yesukreesthu pratyakshamagu varaku neevu nishkalankamugaanu anindyamugaanu ee aagnanu gaikonavalenani neeku aagnaapinchuchunnaanu.
shreemanthudunu advitheeyudunagu sarvaadhipathi yukthakaalamulayandu aa pratyakshathanu kanuparachunu. aa sarvaadhipathi raajulaku raajunu prabhuvulaku prabhuvunai yunnaadu.

sameepimparaani thejassulo aayana maatrame vasinchuchu amaratvamugalavaadaiyunnaadu. Manushyulalo evadunu aayananu choodaledu, evadunu choodaneradu; aayanaku ghanathayu shaashvathamaina prabhaavamunu kaligiyundunu gaaka. aamen‌.

ihamandu dhanavanthulainavaaru garvishtulu kaaka, asthiramaina dhanamunandu nammikayunchaka,sukhamugaa anubha vinchutaku samasthamunu manaku dhaaraalamuga daya cheyu dhevuniyandhe nammikayunchudani aagnaapinchumu.
vaaru vaasthavamaina jeevamunu sampaadhinchukonu nimitthamu, raabovu kaalamunaku manchi punaadhi thamakoraku vesi konuchu, melucheyuvaarunu,
sat‌kriyalu anu dhanamu galavaarunu, audaaryamugalavaarunu, thama dhanamulo itharulaku paalichuvaarunai yundavalenani vaariki aagnaa pinchumu.
o thimothi, neeku appagimpabadinadaanini kaapaadi, apavitramaina vatti maatalakunu, gnaanamani abaddhamugaa cheppabadina vipareethavaadamulakunu dooramugaa undumu.
aa vishayamulo praveenulamani kondharanukoni vishvaasa vishayamu thappipoyiri. Krupa meeku thoodaiyundunugaaka.
